mapper.select: SELECT profile_id, mobile_no, full_name, id_no_ciphertext, id_no_nonce, id_no_tag, id_no_hash, module_status, last_request_id, last_lender_request_json, last_lender_response_json FROM user_profile_identity WHERE profile_id = #{profileId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO user_profile_identity ( profile_id, mobile_no, full_name, id_no_ciphertext, id_no_nonce, id_no_tag, id_no_hash, module_status, last_request_id ) VALUES ( #{profileId}, #{mobileNo}, #{fullName}, #{idNoCiphertext}, #{idNoNonce}, #{idNoTag}, #{idNoHash}, #{moduleStatus}, #{lastRequestId} ) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE mobile_no = VALUES(mobile_no), full_name = VALUES(full_name), id_no_ciphertext = VALUES(id_no_ciphertext), id_no_nonce = VALUES(id_no_nonce), id_no_tag = VALUES(id_no_tag), id_no_hash = VALUES(id_no_hash), module_status = VALUES(module_status), last_request_id = VALUES(last_request_id)
